owner: Mark Youssef, Alex Bourne and Deborah Hyde
summary: A Sydney family and property law firm with hundreds of reviews is a strength, but dead consultation buttons and zero counters appear to cost you free consultations.

findings.problem: The menu items Services, Locations and Book a Free Consultation appear to link to #, and several Free Consultation buttons appear to link to # as well.
findings.cost: A client ready to book a consultation clicks and nothing happens.
findings.fix: Every consultation button leading to one working booking form.

findings.problem: The counters appear to show '0 +' for 5 Star Testimonials and Combined Years of Experience while the text claims 600+ and 8000+.
findings.cost: Zeros on your strongest proof points make the claims look false.

findings.problem: The reviewer name 'R U' appears on several testimonials, an article dated 2024 appears featured as a 2026 guide, and a review dated October 2026 appears later than the newest blog post.
findings.cost: Odd names and mixed dates make reviews look unreal.
findings.fix: Real reviewer names and correct dates.

findings.problem: Divorce Lawyers Sydney and Family Lawyers Sydney appear to point to the homepage, and Bondi appears as an office in the body but Bondi Junction in the footer.
findings.cost: Clients searching for those services land on the wrong page.
findings.fix: Dedicated service pages and consistent office names.

redesign: A working consultation button and form.
Real reviews, correct dates and dedicated service pages.
